a2-unit-41.41.1 Too much chicken:
Lucy: Hi! I'm back. Is anyone home?
Tom: Yes! I'm in the kitchen.
Lucy: There you are! Good news! I just bought groceries for the weekend!
Tom: But I did the shopping for the weekend. I thought you were busy today.
Lucy: I found some time. You said you didn't have much time.
Tom: Well, let's see what you bought. Do you have many bags?
Lucy: I have four.
Tom: Did you get any chilies?
Lucy: I got some chilies and a pack of green beans. I also bought two red peppers and some onions.
Tom: OK, well, I got a few chilies too, and two pounds of onions. I also got a bag of spinach. Did you get any chicken?
Lucy: I did! I got some chicken and some coconut milk.
Tom: Uh oh. I got some chicken too, and some yogurt.
Lucy: We already have a little yogurt in the fridge.
Tom: So it looks like we have too much chicken. What are we going to do?
Lucy: Well, we could put some in the freezer. Or we could make a big curry and invite Kate and Rita over for dinner tonight.
Tom: That's a great idea! We have enough chicken for everyone, and there's plenty of rice in the cupboard.
Lucy: I'm worried we don't have enough vegetables.
Tom: There are three cans of tomatoes in the cupboard, and I think we'll be OK with the spinach and the green beans. We have too many onions, though!
Lucy: Never mind. We can use them next week. They won't go bad.
Tom: That's true.
